close_reason: Signature changed to generic <S: AsRef<str>>(known: &[S]); accepts both &[&str] and &[String]
description: Callers typically hold capability URIs as &[&'static str] constants or as a &[String] vec built from session config. The &[&str] signature forces callers with String-typed URI lists to either collect into a Vec<&str> or use as_str() on every element before calling. The natural call-site type is either &[&'static str] (compile-time constant) or accepting IntoIterator<Item=AsRef<str>>. As a public API this will fossilize — once callers depend on it, changing the signature is a breaking bump. This is worth deciding now.
title: check_known_capabilities signature &[&str] is the wrong boundary for callers
